notes.title: The game will become free!
notes.content: Hello everyone! First of all, I want to thank everyone who bought the game and supported me as a developer! You are awesome! But time goes on, and I would like to make the game free. Respect to everyone who bought the game — you helped me overcome various challenges, but now I want the game to be free. But that's not all! Paid items have appeared in the game, which are given out for free, and you can buy or sell them on the marketplace! Good luck!

notes.content: Hi all! This is a new update and also fixes some bugs. Good luck to all!
